I implemented `convert()` in `src/billing/currency.py`. I haven't run it or added tests.

It multiplies the integer cents by the `Decimal` rate and rounds with `ROUND_FLOOR`, then returns an `int`. The rounding follows the stored Treasury decision from April 2026: a conversion never credits more than the rate allows. It never goes through float, per the integer-cents convention.

Flooring a negative amount, such as a refund or credit note, rounds it further from zero. I followed the decision as written, which doesn't mention negatives. If credits should round the other way, that needs a separate call from Treasury.
